preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the CMOVE contract.
A victim address must exist that is not currently on the blacklist and holds a balance of CMOVE tokens.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `addBlackList` function with a victim's address as the argument. This will add the victim to the `blackListedList` mapping, effectively freezing their tokens as any subsequent transfer attempt will be blocked by the `_beforeTokenTransfer` hook.
